haiku-low.q1: Held 10 minutes (expires_at = created + 10 min). If not confirmed in time, Inventory's sweeper, running every minute, releases it and stock goes back on sale.
haiku-low.q2: Before the charge. If any line is short, the whole order is rejected as REJECTED_SHORT_STOCK, nothing is reserved, no payment is requested, and the cart is untouched.
haiku-low.q3: The idempotency key, the order id, is sent with the charge. On retry the provider returns the original charge instead of making a new one.
haiku-low.q4: Order asks Inventory for one fresh all-or-nothing reservation. If that fails, Payment refunds the full amount, status becomes REFUNDING then CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK, and the customer is emailed.
haiku-low.q5: Only when the Cart service receives OrderConfirmed, which deletes the cart. Every failure path leaves the cart as it was.
haiku-low.q6: The Order service moves checkout between steps. The order's status is the only record of how far a checkout has got.
haiku-low.q7: The provider sends a webhook to Payment, which records the outcome and publishes PaymentSucceeded or PaymentFailed on the message broker for Order to act on.
haiku-low.q8: Payment drops webhooks whose provider payment id is already recorded. Order acts on payment events only while the order is AWAITING_PAYMENT, so repeats are ignored.
haiku-low.q9: Order asks Inventory to release the reservation immediately, not waiting for the sweeper, and sets status PAYMENT_FAILED. The PaymentFailed event triggers this.
haiku-low.q10: Order asks Inventory to confirm the reservation. If it has expired, Order requests one fresh all-or-nothing reservation: if all lines are in stock it commits, otherwise it refunds.
haiku-low.q11: Payment retries the refund every 5 minutes, up to 12 tries. The pending refund is tracked in Payment's refund row (status, attempt count). After 12 failures it is marked MANUAL, support is alerted, and the order stays REFUNDING.
haiku-low.q12: Receiving OrderConfirmed causes the Cart service to delete the cart. Only the Cart service deletes carts.

sonnet.q1: Held for 10 minutes (expires_at = created + 10 min). If not confirmed within 10 min, Inventory's sweeper (runs every minute) releases the reservation and the stock goes back on sale.
sonnet.q2: Stock is reserved before charging. If any line is short, Inventory reserves nothing (all-or-nothing); order becomes REJECTED_SHORT_STOCK, customer is shown the short items, no payment is requested, cart untouched.
sonnet.q3: Retries use the same idempotency key (order id for a charge); the provider returns the original charge instead of making a new one. Payment also keeps one payment row per order.
sonnet.q4: Customer gets a full refund (order status REFUNDING, then Payment refunds the full amount); when PaymentRefunded arrives the order becomes CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK and the customer is emailed (refunded, item sold out). Order is never fulfilled partially.
sonnet.q5: Cart is deleted only after the order is confirmed (Cart service on receiving OrderConfirmed). On every failure path the cart is left as it was.
sonnet.q6: The Order service orchestrates the steps; the record of progress is the order's status in the Order service's own DB.
sonnet.q7: Provider sends a webhook to Payment; Payment records the outcome and publishes PaymentSucceeded or PaymentFailed on the message broker; Order consumes the event and finishes the order.
sonnet.q8: Payment drops a webhook whose provider payment id is already recorded (acknowledges, does nothing). Order acts on a payment event only while the order is AWAITING_PAYMENT, so repeated broker events find it already moved on and are ignored.
sonnet.q9: The reservation is released immediately. Triggered by the Order service, on receiving PaymentFailed, asking Inventory to release it; order status becomes PAYMENT_FAILED and the cart is untouched.
sonnet.q10: Order asks Inventory to confirm the reservation; if expired it makes exactly ONE fresh all-or-nothing reservation of the same lines. If all in stock, it commits stock and confirms the order; if not, it refunds the full amount and the order is cancelled (CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK).
sonnet.q11: Payment marks the refund row PENDING and retries every 5 min, up to 12 tries (about 1 hour). If the 12th fails, the refund is marked MANUAL and support on-call is alerted; order stays REFUNDING. Tracked in Payment's refund row (status, attempt count).
sonnet.q12: Receipt of the OrderConfirmed event (published by Order when CONFIRMED) causes the Cart service to delete the cart; only the Cart service deletes carts.
